title: useChatSession: cleanup during pending api.listen leaks chat listener + bufferedEvents
notes: Imported by S-080 (D-015-04 amended) from the 2026-09-29 re-check: verdict fixed in e6d1c576 (shipped in v1.0.0-rc.10). Re-check evidence: dive/src/hooks/useChatSession.ts:410-415 adds an idempotent stopListening(); after listen resolves, :553-556, :561-563 and the catch path :587-589 call stopListening() when cancelled; cleanup :600-604 also calls it. Landed in e6d1c576 with a useChatSession.test.ts regression test. Guard resolved through its runner on 2026-09-29. Status stays fixed, not verified, until a live re-run on a rebuilt release records evidence.
